property_summary: For all addresses and token ids the reference contract always reverts when balanceOf(address(0), id) is called (i.e. querying balanceOf with the zero address is not a successful view), whereas the mutant returns 0 instead of reverting when account == address(0), so there exists an input (account == address(0)) where the mutant does not revert but the reference does.
change_summary: Change the require that checks account non-zero to instead return 0 without reverting when account is the zero address.
